reason: B is the better proposal because it defines a specific Cu fraction, baseline, operating range, measurable thermal/mechanical targets, and a controlled falsification experiment; W–Cu composites also provide a more plausible thermal-conductivity intervention than isolated W-rich precipitates in an unspecified HEA. However, its claims of coherent, continuous Cu nanoparticle pathways and integrity up to 600°C are weakly supported—especially given Cu-phase immiscibility and the cited Cu-alloy temperature limitations—so confidence is only moderate.
